Ponytail: useful, but not a token saver
items.action: Judge it on code size, not tokens. Viral videos claim 50%+ token savings; the top reply cites the docs saying that is not its purpose.
items.why: Reported 3,629 -> 490 lines on one task; the savings claim is disputed.

more.title: Treat "unlimited free usage" routers with suspicion
more.action: Before installing a router that pools free third-party providers, read its source: your prompts and code pass through it. Unverified community warning, not a confirmed finding.
more.why: A plugin-stack video promoting one drew a 'do not install' reply; verify yourself.
